summary:
Scope: BAR1032 maintained source contract, not invocation or full acceptance. The dispatch-only hosted route has two closed purposes: full-image retains3600 work+120 retirement seconds, while network-prerequisite uses300+120 on the same4CPU/14GiB available/80GiB free/4096-task domain. No user duration, command, backend, retry or resumed store is introduced. The prerequisite never exports/loads/encrypts a candidate; its unused time is not another attempt. Full generation repeats fresh network qualification and still owes complete pinned toolchain/Recoil headers+engine archive/HighBar stock plugin+compiled controls/BAR Rapid game graph+map, static ELF identity, OCI export and separate-store load/readback.

A source composition defect was found before another dispatch:480 prep+3900 unit runtime+120 independent unit stop+1200 transport is5700 seconds, exceeding the5400-second job despite the inner3600+120 gate. Separate retirement layers cannot share one allowance. The new first-step producer requires three Root UTC inputs and one bounded first-attempt native job/source/runner read before checkout. It projects ONCE D=min(provider job start+5400,Root selection+5400) onto the original first-step boot/monotonic domain; queue, provider setup and metadata-read time consume D. Latest first-step is at most300 seconds after selection; the5700-second observer horizon gives no additional work. Root/provider/runner UTC skew is not independently authenticated. Malformed/late/Unknown joins refuse without automatic API retry. A private provenance-fenced startup stage can reach the existing single metadata uploader even without source checkout/helpers; unsafe pre-existing paths are not uploaded.

With L=D-1200 transport-120 independent unit stop-30 final summary, precreation Q selects R=min(3900,floor(L-Q-30 activation reserve)). The fixed root unit entry reads actual ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic U, invocation, mainPID/cgroup, type and fallback properties before namespace entry; U must lie within Q..Q+30 and U+R<=L. systemctl USec duration output is parsed as bounded human spans, not assumed raw integers. RuntimeMax is set only at transient creation: pinned systemd255 permits its transient setter only while UNIT_STUB, so active retiming is not a supported repair. After all wrapper preparation, the adjacent controller gate requires S+purposeWork+120 retirement+30 bookkeeping<=the same actual unit end<=L. Controller clock/purpose is validated in BAR input context; sharedSC2 remains unchanged. Old312.987-second preparation does not establish full-path fit under these margins. Source approval cannot assert native supplier fit.

Checkout bootstrap still removes only the proven fresh-checkout singleton local gc.auto0 and preserves other config. Root domain admission, strict complete source/pin closure, fresh VM/boot/stores, resource admission after base pull, fixed privateNET/PID/IPC/rootless/NNP/pasta/crun and loader/helper/AVX2/library closure remain. Parent/LSM observations retain Unknowns; failed proc access identifies an interface, not its sole denier. No host network, policy, capability or privilege bypass is selected.

Receipt9min, metadata1min and ciphertext10min share1200 seconds; final summary is bounded30 seconds. Optional diagnostics remain secondary; valid JSON1e999/NaN, missing/partial/failed data cannot skip original primary metadata. Expiry or candidate-only refusal cannot authorize transport or manufacture prerequisite success; safe original metadata remains available. Only a verified full candidate can enter CMS AES256GCM AuthEnvelopedData with RSAOAEP SHA256/MGF1SHA256; streaming is BER despite the DER CLI option. Original public recipient and OpenSSL/loader/library identity bind the original clock digest/deadline. Private key/decrypt/independent OCI receiver admission remain operator-only and separately owed.

Static actual producer/wrapper and closed-port controls were selected over a new model/executor: native API/unit properties are inert, actual clock/receipt/fallback joins are exercised, purpose and resource refusals are causal. Focused31 controls, two BAR preflight regressions, seven final clock cases and12 ShellCheck blocks pass. First authoring fixture/registry failures are retained; no native systemd/container/toolchain/crypto ran in this source window. Original failures remain failed; direct-child EOF/reaping, native unit termination and provider physical disposal retain their separate unproved scopes. Full image, loaded ABI, gameplay, B2 adoption and publication acceptance remain open. The historical139.1-second source horizon overrun remains separate from semantic PASS and is not erased by these checks.
title: BAR hosted purpose clocks share one original provider and Root deadline
